title: Majnoon Falsafa
description: Majnoon Falsafa (Majun Falsafa) is a classical, complex Unani electuary prepared with dry fruits, ginger, and specific hot-potency herbs for urinary and joint support. This classical formulation strengthens the kidneys improving kidney function. Supports urinary bladder health. Prevents involuntary urination (bedwetting) through tissue strengthening. Relieves joint pain and gout through anti-inflammatory action. Improves nerve strength.
dosage: 5–10 grams once daily at bedtime with a cup of warm milk
